exposure: Full accepted source files, catalog, concordance, all own prior source/image analyses and spans/viewer already exposed. This is descriptive source-provenance work without statistical tests, blind selection or untouched evaluation.
limits: No manuscript pixels inspected for this contribution, no physical word/glyph validation, source preference/correction, alignment on different chains, modification of pending178/191 fields, historical notation work, language or translation.

markers.<~>: source drawing-interruption notation with vertical misalignment

output: Complete every-selected-key validation summary; every union-disagreement key/offset with both native markers, native raw ranges or null absence, policy cut flags, original source identifiers/file lines/raw-locus hashes; full policy/source/marker count partitions. Retain different-chain keys explicitly as unaligned.
processing: ASCII letters preserve case and order; formatting whitespace and accepted free/text/paragraph annotations contribute no letters/cuts. All native markers split under split policy; commas create no cut under join. Reject unsupported notation and leading/trailing/consecutive separators. Reconstruct all 11760 accepted source/policy token arrays and whole-locus annotation counts before cross-source reporting.
raw_coordinates: Half-open character offsets in the exact parsed logical locus text, after IVTFF file continuation assembly and outer strip; not physical-file bytes, image coordinates or manuscript spaces.
scope: All 2940 accepted common eligible native P0 keys are traced source-internally under split/join. Cross-source positions are compared only on the 2054 exactly identical case-preserved ASCII chains. Retain every offset with a source-only cut in either policy; no readability or folio filtering.
